fields.h1: Build a Sales Questionnaire Template That Sorts Your Leads
fields.hero_description: Build a sales questionnaire template that asks each prospect the right questions and sends the answers to the right rep.
fields.features_heading: What a Rep Needs to Know Before the Call
fields.features_subheading: A template on paper waits for someone to read it. Emergent builds a questionnaire whose answers reach a rep before the call.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the deal

Ask first what the prospect wants to buy. A software buyer then answers questions about team size and current tools, and a services buyer about project scope and launch date.
fields.feature_2:
Large prospects reach a senior rep

Set the line that makes a deal large, such as 50 staff or a $20,000 budget. Anyone above it goes to an account executive in Slack, and everyone else reaches the team by email.
fields.feature_3:
Answers written to the deal in your CRM

Connect HubSpot or any CRM with an API. Each finished questionnaire writes its answers onto the matching deal, where the rep also keeps the call notes and the next step.
fields.feature_4:
One question per screen on a phone

Prospects open the link from an email on their phone. The questionnaire shows one question at a time, with a large button for each answer and a progress bar along the top.
fields.feature_5:
Every answer kept in a database you own

Responses land in a database table you own, with no cap on how many prospects can answer each month. Filter by deal size, industry or timeline when you plan the quarter.
fields.feature_6:
The questionnaire's code, in your repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and host it next to the sales tools you already run. Anyone on the team can keep building on it from there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Sales Questionnaires With Emergent?
fields.why_description: A downloaded template stops at the questions. Emergent builds what happens next: the rep who hears about it, and where answers are kept.

How do I create a sales questionnaire template?

plan.angle: The top 10 is static pre-sales and seller questionnaire templates (form-builder template galleries, a printable seller form, county sales verification sheets): each gives a list of questions and stops there. This page treats the sales questionnaire template as a working qualification app: questions that branch by deal type, answers that send big prospects to an account executive, seller details in an agent's inbox before the listing appointment, and lost-deal reasons counted on a dashboard.
tab_stories: Orvanta sells shift scheduling software; a home care agency with 140 caregivers answers the pre-demo questionnaire, and because it has 50 or more staff the app messages account executive Feodora Halcott in Slack.

Saltreed Studio, a web design shop, asks first whether a prospect wants a new site or a redesign; a redesign answer opens questions about the current site, and the founder reads the record before the discovery call.

Mirovale Realty sends its seller questionnaire before each listing appointment; a seller on Neddick Lane reports a 2021 roof and a June 30 move date, and agent Pradeep Lumsley gets the answers by email.

Caddenby, an inventory software company, sends a 4-question questionnaire to every buyer who chose another vendor; 23 replies last quarter, 9 of them naming price, are counted on a dashboard and saved to each deal in HubSpot.
